name: Lawless YN
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve adult character's short waves, sunglasses, pale-gray tracksuit, gloves and gray fist sneakers. Keep reference sidearm lowered and unused; action is a stylized displacement kick against a padded dummy. Review heel contact, target trajectory to distant group, eyewear and cyan keying of pale-gray fabric.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Lawless YN — Wrong Block.
IDENTITY: exact young ADULT dark-skinned man with short black waves and close fade, narrow black sunglasses, pale-gray zip-up hooded tracksuit and matching cargo joggers, black gloves, dark gray sneakers with white fist patches. Preserve the reference's small black sidearm as a lowered, unused prop in his right hand; it does not discharge, aim at anyone or change shape. His free arm and legs perform the action. Keep him stylish and controlled.
0–0.7s: establish full figure as he slips sideways around a large charcoal padded training dummy drifting into his space. He tilts his head at the dummy as if it has made a serious navigational mistake.
0.7–2.5s: with one explosive pivot he delivers a spectacular spinning HEEL KICK to the dummy's padded middle. Show clear boot contact with a giant bounded ivory/orange impact star and a tiny contact hold. Camera whips around his shoulder to chase the dummy rocketing far into cyan depth, propelled through THREE widely separated giant orange directional chevrons. Each chevron gives it another cartoon speed boost. Pull out to reveal its destination: two much larger stationary padded dummies. The small dummy shoots neatly into the gap between them, bumps both with a huge rubbery THUD and wobbles helplessly while the larger two lean inward. This is comic relocation using faceless training props, no injury, buildings or street backdrop.
2.5–3.5s: snap-zoom back to his face as he finishes the kick in a low full-body stance. He gestures dismissively toward the faraway dummy with his free left thumb. Exact title WRONG BLOCK slams below his sunglasses in two powerful lines.
3.5–5s: pull back to show both sneakers and the whole character. He straightens one cuff, then nudges his sunglasses into place with his free hand. Far behind him the small dummy makes one last tiny wobble between its oversized neighbors. Stable face, outfit and title. SFX: pivot shoe squeak, accelerating spin whoosh, one massive padded kick CRACK, three rising pass-by whistles, distant rubber collision, title slam and subtle sunglasses click. No gunfire, music or speech.
